title: Smoked Salmon Tea Sandwiches
description: Classic French-inspired tea sandwiches featuring smoked salmon, silky cream cheese, and a hint of mustard.
instructions: 1. In a small bowl, mix together the softened cream cheese and a pinch of mustard.
2. Lay out the sliced bread on a clean surface.
3. Spread a small amount of the mustardy cream cheese onto each slice of bread.
4. Top each slice with a few pieces of smoked salmon.
5. Season with black pepper to taste.
6. Cut the sandwiches into quarters or halves, depending on your preference.
